name: Bøjg
body:
BØJG
CR 8

The furry, slimy mass twists around you leaving no avenue for escape.

XP 4,800
CE Huge aberration
Init +2; Senses blindsense 120 ft.; Perception +0

DEFENSE

AC 22, touch 10, flat-footed 20 (+2 Dex, +12 natural, -2 size)
hp 105 (10d8+60); regeneration 5 (does not work at 0 hp or lower)
Fort +9, Ref +5, Will +5
Defensive Abilities misty body; DR 5/bludgeoning; Immune acid, mind-affecting; Resist cold 10, electricity 10, fire 10; SR 17
Weaknesses lazy, sunlight weakness

OFFENSE

Speed 60 ft.
Melee bite +14 (2d6+12)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 15 ft.
Special Attacks bewildering engulf (DC 23)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 10th; concentration +7)

3/day—quickened dimension door

STATISTICS

Str 26, Dex 14, Con 22, Int 6, Wis 7, Cha 5
Base Atk +7; CMB +17 (+19 grapple); CMD 29 (can’t be grappled or tripped)
Feats Dimensional Agility, Improved Grapple, Improved Unarmed Strike, Power Attack, Weapon Focus (bite)
Skills Acrobatics +7, Climb +16, Perception +0, Stealth +2, Survival +5
Languages Common, Giant

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Bewildering Engulf (Ex)

A bøjg can engulf Large or smaller creatures in its path as a standard action. It cannot make a bite attack during a round in which it engulfs. The bøjg merely has to move over the opponents, affecting as many as it can cover. Opponents can make attacks of opportunity against the cube, but if they do so they are not entitled to a saving throw. Those who do not attempt attacks of opportunity can attempt a DC 23 Reflex save to avoid being engulfed—on a success, they are pushed back or aside (opponent’s choice) as the creature moves forward. Engulfed creatures are dealt 2d8+12 damage each round on the bøjg’s turn and are grappled.

The bøjg does not gain the grappled condition and does not need to maintain the grapple so long as the creatures are engulfed.

Additionally, the bøjg has concealment against creatures they have grappled using this ability. The save DC is Strength-based.

Lazy (Ex)

A bøjg takes a -5 penalty on saves that cause sleep, fatigue, or exhaustion as well as Perception checks.

Misty Body (Su)

A bøjg can cause their body to be indistinct and difficult to follow. As an immediate action in response to being attacked, the bøjg can gain concealment against that attack. Once this ability has been used the Bøjg must wait 1d4 rounds before using it again.

Sunlight Weakness (Ex)

When exposed to sunlight or bright light, like from a daylight spell, for 3 or more rounds, or takes 15 or more damage from a spell with the light descriptor, the bøjg’s slime hardens and crumbles off. The bøjg loses their regeneration and spell resistance until they can be in a cool, damp, dark place for 1 minute.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary
Treasure incidental

A vast, slimy, slippery, twisting shape, the bøjg delights in confusing and frustrating its prey, twisting itself around and around its victims and watching them slowly despair as they repeatedly run into the bøjg, no matter which way they turn.

Fond of slowly encircling their prey before consuming them, the bøjg will circle around a victim or even encircle small houses before attempting to devour them. When circled, their victims will see nothing but a swirling wall of indeterminate, misty, slimy flesh that seems to shrug off injuries.

Difficult to take down and seemingly impervious to many types of harm, the bøjg can be engaged and can potentially be distracted with offerings of food and drink or scared away.
